rules.statement: A partition action may proceed even if there is a discrepancy in the extent of the land described in the schedule to the plaint and the preliminary plan, if the surveyor's report is satisfactory and the deeds through which rights are claimed are consistent with the plaint.
rules.supporting_quote: It shall not be used as a convenient method to summarily dispose of long-drawn-out and complicated partition actions without embarking on the arduous task of investigating the title of each party.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: Section 18(1)(a)(iii) of the Partition Law No. 21 of 1977
